Quick Start

Getting Started

Get from zero to your first AI response in a few minutes. zingTechie runs locally, owns authentication, and exposes a REST API your automation can call.

Local-firstREST APIMulti-model
  1. 1
    Launch the app

    Start zingTechie locally and open the dashboard (default: http://localhost:3000).

  2. 2
    Sign up / Sign in

    Create an account or log in. Session is JWT-based and stored for persistence.

  3. 3
    Connect GitHub Copilot

    In Settings (or via the Token & Device Login API), start the GitHub device-login flow to authenticate and obtain a Copilot token. Tokens stay server-side — your automation never holds them.

  4. 4
    Send your first prompt

    Go to Chat Workspace, pick a model, and send a message. Responses stream in real time. Use Compare Models to run the same prompt against multiple models.

  5. 5
    Call the API from your tools

    Point Selenium, Playwright, or any HTTP client at the local REST endpoints (e.g. POST /api/chat). Auth and token management stay inside zingTechie.

  • Local AI workspace with multi-model chat and side-by-side comparison
  • GitHub device-flow support for Copilot token management
  • 50+ REST endpoints for chat, sessions, models, stats, and audit
  • Persistent sessions with export (Markdown / JSON) and email
  • Designed so test automation and scripts never hold secrets
  • Dashboard with live token health, model cache, and usage

Authentication

Sign In

Secure entry point to your zingTechie workspace. Authenticate with your email and password to access the full platform.

JWTREST APISecure
Open page ↗
localhost:3000/login.html
  1. 1
    Open the app

    Navigate to localhost:3000 or your hosted URL.

  2. 2
    Enter credentials

    Type your registered email address and password.

  3. 3
    Click Sign In

    You will be redirected to the Dashboard on success.

  4. 4

    Use the "Create account" link to go to the Sign Up page.

  • JWT-based session authentication
  • Token stored in localStorage for persistence
  • Auto-redirect if already authenticated
  • Direct link to create a new account
  • Responsive layout for all screen sizes

Sign Up

Create a new user account to get started. All accounts are stored locally for easy self-hosted deployment.

bcryptLocal StorageValidation
Open page ↗
localhost:3000/signup.html
  1. 1
    Go to Sign Up

    Click "Create account" on the login page.

AI Assistant

Chat Workspace

Write prompts, compare model outputs side-by-side, and save conversations as reusable sessions. Supports streaming replies.

Multi-modelStreamingCompare
Open page ↗
localhost:3000/chat.html
  1. 1
    Select a model

    Choose your AI model from the dropdown in the Prompt composer panel.

  2. 2
    Write a prompt

    Type your message in the textarea and click Send Prompt or press Enter.

  3. 3
    View response

    Streamed reply appears in the output panel with markdown rendering.

  4. 4
    Compare models

    Click Compare Models to run the same prompt against multiple models.

  5. 5
    Save session

    Click Save Session to persist the conversation for later review.

  • Multi-model support (GitHub Copilot models, local, custom endpoints)
  • Markdown and code-block rendering
  • Side-by-side model comparison
  • Full session history with timestamps
  • Session save, rename, and delete
  • Token usage tracking per conversation

localhost:3000/settings.html

  • SMTP configuration for email delivery

Token & Device Login

4 endpoints
Note: These endpoints support GitHub’s official device-flow pattern for obtaining a Copilot-related token. This is an unofficial integration. Review GitHub’s terms of service before use in production or shared environments. Prefer storing tokens server-side only; never commit them.
MethodEndpointDescription
POST /api/token/save Save global Copilot token
POST /api/token/clear Clear global token
POST /api/device-login/start Start GitHub device login flow
POST /api/device-login/poll Poll for device login completion
